overview.zh: 桌面发送的命令帧包含 CMD ID 和 schema 固定的 payload。payload_bytes 不包含 FE/LEN/CMD/FF 头尾；帧构造器检查 ID 和长度，P4 再按状态、安全规则和字段值决定 ACK。特别区分 START、RUN_FEEDBACK、RUN_DIRECT、STOP 与 RESET。
overview.en: Desktop command frames carry a CMD ID and schema-defined payload. payload_bytes excludes FE/LEN/CMD/FF framing; the frame builder checks ID/length and P4 applies state, safety, and value checks before ACK. START, RUN_FEEDBACK, RUN_DIRECT, STOP, and RESET have distinct meanings.

zh.plain: 下行命令目录；每个命令固定编号与 payload 长度，发送端和 P4 dispatcher 共享生成协议表。 payload 长度与命令编号由共享协议表固定，写帧成功仍需确认 P4 ACK。
zh.condition: 协议条件：`共享协议命令枚举与 payload schema。`。发送由相应 UI/backend handler 触发，P4 另行校验。
zh.effect: 调用方按命令字段组 payload，再由 frame builder 校验命令编号与长度。
zh.failure: 未知 ID 或 payload 长度不匹配会在组帧时拒绝；P4 还可按状态/安全策略返回拒绝 ACK。
zh.recovery: 对照命令定义和生成器 --check，定位调用 handler 的参数组装。
zh.unknown: 静态协议定义不证明命令已写到串口或 P4 已接受。
zh.difference: items 的功能见命令 ID 与 payload schema；它不等于相邻命令。
zh.change: 基线未标记该命令为本次变更。

en.plain: Downlink command catalog; each command has a fixed ID and payload length shared by the sender and P4 dispatcher. Its fixed ID and payload size define the wire format; a host write still needs P4 ACK confirmation.
en.condition: Protocol condition: `共享协议命令枚举与 payload schema。`. A UI/backend handler sends it; P4 validates it independently.
en.effect: Callers build the payload for each command; the frame builder validates command ID and length.
en.failure: Unknown IDs or wrong payload lengths are rejected during framing; P4 can also return a state/safety rejection ACK.
en.recovery: Compare the command definition and generator --check, then inspect the caller’s payload construction.
en.unknown: The static protocol definition does not prove the command reached serial or P4 accepted it.
en.difference: The role of items comes from its ID and payload schema; it is distinct from neighboring commands.
en.change: The baseline does not mark this command as changed.
